sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Declares the word list shape
sections.what: Tells TypeScript that importing the word list package gives a list of text strings. The package itself is unchanged.
sections.why: Stated in the code: the package has no type declarations of its own.
sections.watch_out: This is a promise that TypeScript will not verify against the real package.

summary: Tells TypeScript that the English word list package gives a list of text strings.
purpose: Lets code import the word list without TypeScript reporting a missing type error.
why: Stated in the code: the package ships without type declarations, so this file supplies them.
how: 1. TypeScript sees an import of the package name. 2. This file declares its default value as a list of text strings. 3. Code that imports the package gets that type.
inputs: None at run time. The file is read only by the TypeScript compiler.
outputs: Type information only. No code is produced.
risks: The declared type is a promise that TypeScript does not check against the real package.
debug: If a word list import shows a type error, check that the module name matches the package name exactly, and check what the package actually exports.
